title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Arizona State University Campus Immersion
description: Build an under-21-safe late-night ritual board. Every card needs a currently verifiable destination, a direct source supporting late availability, and a conservative explanation of why it matters near this campus. Do not invent student habits, signature orders, popularity, or current hours. Bars and 21+-only venues are prohibited.

cards.title: Gus's New York Pizza
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Pizza on Rural Road
cards.notes: Order a slice at this 24-hour staple located just east of campus. It is a reliable destination for students needing a meal during overnight study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour pizza shop on Rural Road serving the ASU community at all hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Gus's New York Pizza at 829 S Rural Rd is open 24 hours a day for pickup and delivery.
cards.source_title: Gus New York Pizza Tempe AZ - Pizza Delivery 24 hours a day
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for walk-ins, pickup, and delivery.

cards.title: Filiberto's Mexican Food
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Mexican Food on Apache Blvd
cards.notes: Visit this 24-hour Mexican spot for carne asada fries or burritos. It is located near the south edge of campus and stays open through the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 Mexican restaurant on Apache Boulevard popular for late-night meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Filiberto's Mexican Food at 1270 E Apache Blvd offers 24/7 service for walk-in and drive-thru customers.
cards.source_title: Filibertos Mexican Food – Arizona's Favorite Mexican Food

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Warm Cookies Until 3 AM
cards.notes: Stop by for warm cookies or ice cream sandwiches until 3 AM on weekends. This bakery is a frequent late-night stop for students in Downtown Tempe.
cards.short_summary: A late-night bakery in Downtown Tempe serving warm cookies until 3 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies at 116 E University Dr is open until 1 AM Sunday-Wednesday and 3 AM Thursday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3 AM on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Dutch Bros Coffee
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Caffeine on Apache Blvd
cards.notes: Grab a Rebel energy drink or a coffee at this drive-thru stand open until 11 PM or midnight. It is a common stop for students on the south side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A popular drive-thru coffee stand on Apache Boulevard with late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Dutch Bros Coffee at 1037 E Apache Blvd is open until 11 PM Sunday-Thursday and 12 AM Friday-Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until midnight on weekends.

cards.title: Raising Cane's
cards.subtitle: Chicken Fingers Near Campus
cards.notes: Visit the University Drive location for chicken finger combos until 2 AM. The drive-thru is a frequent late-night destination for students.
cards.short_summary: A fast-food restaurant on University Drive open until 2 AM for late-night dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's at 960 E University Dr is open until 2 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Tempe, AZ, - 960 E. University Drive

cards.title: Cheba Hut
cards.subtitle: Toasted Subs Until Midnight
cards.notes: Order a toasted sub and 'munchies' at this themed sandwich shop until midnight. It is located just west of the main campus area.
cards.short_summary: A themed sandwich shop on University Drive serving toasted subs until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Cheba Hut at 960 W University Dr is open until midnight every day of the week.
cards.source_title: Sandwiches & Sub Shop in Tempe 85281 - Cheba Hut

cards.title: Munchie Stop
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Mediterranean on Mill
cards.notes: Head to Mill Avenue for late-night Mediterranean food and wings. This spot operates specifically during late-night hours, often until 5 AM.
cards.short_summary: A late-night Mediterranean eatery on Mill Avenue operating until 5 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Munchie Stop at 1020 S Mill Ave is open from 9:30 PM to 5:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Info & Hours | Munchie Stop - Beyond Menu
cards.access_notes: Open late night only, from 9:30 PM to 5 AM.

cards.title: Memorial Union P.O.D. Market
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Convenience Until 10 PM
cards.notes: Grab snacks or a quick meal at the central campus P.O.D. Market. It serves as a primary late-evening resource for students in the Memorial Union.
cards.short_summary: A central campus convenience store in the Memorial Union open until 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: The P.O.D. Market in the Memorial Union is open until 10 PM Monday through Sunday during the academic semester.
cards.source_title: Tempe | Sun Devil Hospitality - Arizona State University
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 PM daily during the semester.

cards.title: Tooker House P.O.D. Market
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Snacks for Engineers
cards.notes: Visit the P.O.D. Market at Tooker House for late-night snacks and 'Tenders, Love, and Chicken.' It is a key resource for students on the north side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A convenience store and grill located in Tooker House serving students late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Tooker House P.O.D. Market is open until 2 AM for late-night dining and snacks.
cards.source_title: Tempe | Sun Devil Hospitality - Arizona State University
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 AM for late-night service.

cards.title: Snakes & Lattes
cards.subtitle: Board Games and Late-Night Snacks
cards.notes: Play board games while enjoying snacks and coffee at this 6th Street venue. It provides a social, alcohol-free alternative for late-night hangouts.
cards.short_summary: A board game cafe in Downtown Tempe offering late-night gaming and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Snakes & Lattes Tempe is open until 11 PM or later, hosting trivia and social gaming events for students.
cards.source_title: Board Game Bar & Restaurant in Tempe, AZ - Snakes & Lattes
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM or midnight depending on the day; under-21 friendly.
